page_title: MNU 1-0 WOL | Manchester Utd v Wolves 14/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Gary O'Neil appears to have said too much and referee Simon Hooper comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+7' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
90+7' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Wolves! Let's see what he decides.
90+6' Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+5' Craig Dawson (Wolves) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+4' The game is interrupted due to a pitch invader!
90+4' Wolves quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
90+2' The attendance is 73358.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Fabio Silva (Wolves) inside the box.

88' Max Kilman (Wolves) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
88' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Joao Gomes will be replaced by Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Scott McTominay (Manchester United) coming on for Marcus Rashford.

85' Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
84' Fabio Silva (Wolves) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Andre Onana makes a great save.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:14.
83' Pedro Neto (Wolves) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

83' What a wasted opportunity by Fabio Silva (Wolves)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
81' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
77' Substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matheus Cunha (Wolves) walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fabio Silva.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antony trots off the pitch and is replaced by Facundo Pellistri (Manchester United).
76' 1 - 0 Goal! Aaron Wan-Bissaka plays the ball into the area and Raphael Varane (Manchester United) gets on the end of it to glance a header into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
75' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) works the corner short.

74' Jadon Sancho (Manchester United) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
72' Pedro Neto (Wolves) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Andre Onana is alert and denies him with a nice save.
71' The corner from Pedro Neto (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence.
69' Pedro Neto (Wolves) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
68' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Jadon Sancho (Manchester United) replaces Alejandro Garnacho.
68' Mason Mount will be replaced by Christian Eriksen (Manchester United).
67' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went well wide of the left post.
63' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Simon Hooper signals a foul.
63' Substitution. Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) in, Pablo Sarabia out.
62' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.

61' Ambitious effort from Antony (Manchester United). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
60' Manchester Utd take a short corner kick.
59' A rebound falls at the feet of Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
59' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared.
56' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
55' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the bottom right corner, but Andre Onana shows his agility and makes a save.
55' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sends the corner into the box, but Jose Sa intercepts it and averts the threat.
53' Antony (Manchester United) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
52' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
49' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the left post!
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.
47' Pedro Neto (Wolves) dribbles into the box, but Andre Onana is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Erik ten Hag makes a half-time substitution. Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) comes on in place of Lisandro Martinez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
45+2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the corner.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

45+1' Antony (Manchester United) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
44' 5:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
42' The ball falls kindly for Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post.
40' Flag goes up against Matheus Cunha (Wolves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' The foul by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
35' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves).
34' Matheus Nunes (Wolves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
33' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
30' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
27' Mario Lemina (Wolves) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Matheus Cunha picks out Pablo Sarabia (Wolves), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
24' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United).
22' The game is interrupted as Matheus Nunes (Wolves) is flagged offside.
20' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester Utd. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
14' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
13' A dangerous looking corner kick from Mason Mount (Manchester United) is cleared to safety by the defence.

12' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Jose Sa blocks the shot with his legs.
8' Mason Mount (Manchester United) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
7' The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
7' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) and blew his whistle.
4' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has just begun.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Simon Hooper was nominated as the referee for this game.
